svg.title: Rita Hermes fixes from the fresh-install gauntlet
svg.desc: Four observed faults, their root causes, implemented fixes, and verification.
svg.text: Changes kept at the integration seams; no schema migration required

g.text: Orphan PowerShell supervisor retained the old environment and reacquired the mutex.
Fix: stop the verified bridge child and powershell/pwsh supervisor before replacing files.
Hermes exposes Deft tools as mcp_deft_*, while the policy hook recognized other prefixes.
Fix: recognize the real trusted namespace; external writes remain blocked by policy.
SUCCESSFUL WORK REPORTED AS VALIDATION FAILURE
Idle status serialized event_id as null although the API accepts an omitted optional string.
Fix: omit event_id when idle; bridge contract test verifies the request shape.
DUPLICATE LONG AGENT RUN AFTER TRANSPORT DROP
A generic HTTP retry replayed the non-idempotent Hermes inference POST after ambiguous acceptance.
Fix: no blind inference replay; fail closed and resume through the durable channel event.
Verified: 12 bridge tests · 5 plugin tests · PowerShell parse · live fresh-install completion
